title: vulpia geniculata subsp. pauana
intro: Vulpia geniculata subsp. pauana, commonly known as Pauan Vulpia, is a plant species in the Poaceae family, specifically a grass that is native to the Andean region. Pauan Vulpia has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, inflammation, and as a diuretic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, which can help relieve symptoms such as coughs, colds, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Pauan Vulpia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
